scope.title: Search & discovery audit
scope.purpose: Verify that Wave 5 content is findable from global Search, homepage entry points, main navigation and canonical entity aliases without recreating retired directories or cloning BetterGov/BetterLGU data.

entryPoints.evidence: Home hero renders the shared site-wide ServiceSearch.
Desktop and mobile navigation both expose /search.
Dedicated /search surface uses the same canonical Search component.

discoverability: canonical heritage places through Place Registry

searchSemantics.fuzzyMatching: Token-level fuzzy matching remains enabled for words of four or more characters.
searchSemantics.canonicalDeduplication: Search collapses results by canonicalKey when one exists and otherwise by group/href/title.
searchSemantics.legislation: Full legislation remains lazily loaded for queries of at least three characters instead of cloning the whole index into the static bundle.
searchSemantics.civicTimeline: Timeline terms enrich an existing canonical result where canonical keys match; unmatched canonical timeline owners appear once as Record results.
searchSemantics.organizations: Canonical organizations now have a dedicated Organizations filter rather than being grouped under Government.

legacyTerms.treatment: Search alias only; no retired What's On result is restored.
Search keywords resolve to Explore Makati.
No dedicated BetterMakati Parking result is restored; /parking remains compatibility redirect only.

ecosystem.rule: BetterGov and BetterLGU are external fallback handoffs, not local canonical Search entities.
ecosystem.betterGov: Search national services on BetterGov appears only in the no-result state.
ecosystem.betterLgu: Find another LGU on BetterLGU appears only in the no-result state.

navigation.note: Explore Makati navigation now exposes Areas & Districts alongside city starting points, mobility, cinemas, heritage and history.

bounded.reason: Search remains deterministic token/fuzzy matching plus curated aliases; no opaque AI ranking is introduced.
BetterGov and BetterLGU remain handoffs rather than duplicated local search records.
Parking and What's On are not restored as canonical search destinations.

fixes: Added explicit What's On/events/upcoming/schedule aliases to Makati Calendar.
Expanded Explore Makati aliases for Visit Makati, visitor guide, tourist and things-to-do language.
Expanded Makati in the News aliases for current affairs/current events wording.
Added stable canonical keys to History entries, Barangays and Civic Registry results.
Added a dedicated Organizations Search filter and removed private/civic organizations from the Government filter.
Added Areas & Districts to the Explore Makati navigation menu.
